artworks.title: Man Scraping a Grill
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a fantastical creature in profile walking to the left. The creature is in a dynamic pose, with one leg lifted off the ground and arms folded in front of its chest. It has exaggerated facial features, large drooping ears, and a full, bushy head of hair that extends into long, thin locks. The creature is wearing a textured coat and pants with gathered fabric at the cuffs, simple shoes, and is holding an object that resembles a string instrument or apparatus. There is no visible jewelry, and the background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: The Violin Player
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure with exaggerated features, holding a violin and a bow. The character has large eyes, a prominent nose, a wide mouth, and long hair flowing from under a hat. The attire consists of a tunic or robe, wide-legged trousers, and shoes. The background is plain, and the image is rendered in monochromatic ink on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Man Preparing to Draw His Sword
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature-like figure in a hunched position, appearing to walk to the right. The figure has exaggerated facial features, long whiskers, messy hair covered by a large hat, and wears a loose tunic with a belt and shoes. They hold a stick-like object in one hand. The background is plain with sketchy lines indicating the ground, all rendered in a sketchy style on a textured surface.

artworks.title: Masked Man with Twisted Feet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving//one of four prints on uncut sheet of Lorrainese paper (1949.5.260.a-d)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of a fantastical creature or character. This figure is standing with a confident and slightly leaning posture. The creature has exaggerated facial features, including a prominent hooked nose and bulging eyes, with long strands extending from the back of its head. It is wearing a simplistic, one-piece garment that fits snugly around its body, with visible stitching and folds. A sword is slung across the back, held in place by a belt at the waist, with the hilt visible on the right side of the figure. The background is a plain, light-colored surface with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: The Steamboat, Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a harbor scene with buildings on the distant shore, sailboats on the water, and a high horizon line. The artwork is created using delicate lines to depict the sky, water, and reflections. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between light and dark. In the foreground, there is a small object, while sailboats lead to the busy harbor.

artworks.title: Venetian Water-Carrier
artworks.medium: drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length sketch of a standing person wearing a long, flowing garment that covers their body. The person's head is covered with a veil or headscarf, and their facial features are softly sketched and slightly obscured by shading. The hair is not visible. There are no objects or jewelry visible. The background is neutrally shaded without distinct features, emphasizing the central figure.

artworks.title: Alderney Street
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with various buildings and urban activities. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, and many buildings and people are visible. The horizon is obscured by tall buildings in the background. The style is loose and sketchy, with fine lines indicating figures, buildings, and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, using sepia or pencil gray tones on an off-white background. Near the viewer, a person and a horse-drawn carriage are depicted. Further away, more figures and another carriage are shown, adding to the urban scene. The distant buildings are outlined with simple linear details.

artworks.title: Little Dordrecht
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy harbor scene with various figures and objects sketched intricately across the composition. The point of view is slightly elevated, allowing a view of the activity on the docks and the boats in the water. The horizon is in the upper third of the image with ship masts piercing the sky. The line work appears delicate and linear, possibly created through an etching technique. The color scheme consists mainly of sepia tones. Various figures are engaged in activities near wheelbarrow-like objects, with ships anchored in the waterway beyond. Thin lines in the distance suggest land or clouds against the sky.

artworks.title: A Sketch at Dieppe
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a landscape with figures throughout. The horizon shows outlines of a bluff and buildings. The sketch uses light pencil lines on warm, sepia paper. Various figures are depicted in the foreground and background, along with some ships. The drawing has a calm atmosphere with minimal detailing.

artworks.title: A Corner of the Palais Royal
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch viewed from a slightly elevated point, focusing on an architectural scene with a grand building featuring columns. The horizon is not clearly defined, and the drawing emphasizes architectural details and figures. The central structure has an arched opening and a classical facade, sketched with loose lines. The technique uses quick strokes, giving an impressionistic feel. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of brown and sepia. Figures in motion and a horse-drawn carriage are depicted closer to the viewer, suggesting a bustling public area. Additional structures are hinted at in the background.

artworks.title: A Sketch of the Embankment
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a view overlooking a river or body of water. The horizon is in the upper third, with a faint cityscape outline in the distance. Several figures are drawn standing in a relaxed manner near the water. Delicate pencil lines outline the figures and structures, creating a light and understated visual impact.

artworks.title: The Menpes Children
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of four figures. The left side shows two seated figures, while the right side shows one standing figure and one seated figure. The figures on the left are sitting side by side, with one wearing a hat. The standing figure on the right is dressed simply with a hat, and the seated figure next to them is a child. The sketch is done in a sparse style against a blank background.

artworks.title: Savoy Scaffolding
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a construction site with scaffolding and tools. The drawing features detailed scaffolding structures erected around an unseen building as viewed from the exterior. There are figures sketched on the scaffold platform, and a wheelbarrow is lightly sketched at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Furniture Shop
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a direct frontal perspective, capturing a scene with a rustic appearance. The horizon is not distinctly marked but can be inferred to lie near the top third of the image, with elements suggesting a building structure and possible rooftops extending horizontally. The style of the work is characterized by loose, sketch-like brushstrokes, using fine, thin lines to suggest forms and shadows. The color palette is predominantly monochromatic, featuring various shades of soft, warm beige as the background, with brownish-black lines defining the objects. Closest to us, there is a suggestion of a street market or an outdoor display with outlines reminiscent of tents or awnings, and some indistinct forms suggesting goods or furniture. In the distance, the sketched lines become less detailed, blending into the textured background, providing depth and a sense of space to the scene.

artworks.title: Shaving and Shampooing
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the exterior of a barbershop with a sign that reads "Shaving and Shampooing." Several people are seen standing outside the shop under an awning. The storefront window displays various items and paper notices, with shadows indicating depth. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and minimal shading and hatching to suggest volume and texture, particularly on the figures and building.

artworks.title: King's Road, Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. The sketch captures various architectural elements and figures in an urban setting. The composition includes outlines of buildings with archways and facades, people engaged in different activities, some walking and others seemingly standing or interacting. Among these elements, there is a depiction of a cart and a sign that reads 'ROGERO'. The drawing employs a loose, sketchy line style that suggests movement and life.

artworks.title: Little Maunder's
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a two-story house as the main focus. The viewpoint is facing the house directly. The base of the building implies the horizon. The sketch uses sparse, quick, and loose brushstrokes, suggesting an impressionistic style. The color scheme is minimal, with a light beige background and dark lines for detailing the structure. The drawing includes hints of figures near the house, and its simplicity gives a sense of spontaneity and captures the essence of the scene.

artworks.title: Christ Washing the Apostles' Feet
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11 × 22 cm (4 5/16 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures inside a large architectural space. The scene is depicted in an engraving style, showcasing an interior with arches and high ceilings, represented with line work. Several figures are dressed in robes, congregating and engaged in a discussion or observation. In the foreground, there are containers. The image consists of light and shadow, highlighting the architectural features and figures. In the midground, two figures are seated in a posture, possibly interacting. The artwork conveys a sense of historical or religious context, with an emphasis on the serene and reflective nature of the composition.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.9 × 22.6 cm (4 11/16 × 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large dining scene set in an interior space with classical architectural elements. The scene features an elongated table around which figures are seated and interacting. One figure appears significant, with radiating lines surrounding the head. Other figures are engaged in various activities, including passing and receiving objects. The room has high walls with deep recessed areas and ornamental reliefs. The atmosphere is formal and composed, with attention to symmetry and balance. Line work adds texture and depth, enhancing the details of the figures' garments and the architectural features. Latin text at the bottom of the image adds a layer of narrative or context to the scene.

artworks.title: The Condemnation to Death
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12 × 22.5 cm (4 3/4 × 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a grand scene in a dome-like architectural setting. The composition shows a central figure seated on a raised platform under a domed alcove surrounded by pillars. Numerous figures are gathered around the central figure, engaging in various interactions. The scene conveys a sense of grandeur and ceremony, with detailed clothing folds and architectural elements. The arrangement of figures and classical architectural elements suggest a historical or allegorical theme.

artworks.title: The Crowning with Thorns
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11 × 21.2 cm (4 5/16 × 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures in an architectural setting. Multiple figures are shown in various poses, engaging in a narrative or drama set in a courtyard or palace. There is a group of figures on the right-hand side, some carrying tools or weapons. On the left, a few figures appear to be standing on a flight of stairs. In the background, a balcony is visible with additional figures looking over. The drawing features intricate line work and detailed cross-hatching typical of engravings from the Baroque period, conveying depth and drama through the use of shadow and light. The architecture and attire suggest a historical setting.

artworks.title: The Ecce Homo
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a grand architectural setting with many figures engaged in various activities. The scene includes elaborate architectural elements like columns, arches, pediments, windows, and relief sculptures, creating a sense of grandeur and historical context. Shadows and linework are used effectively to create depth and movement in the piece.

artworks.title: The Carrying of the Cross
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a large crowd, soldiers, and a procession. The composition includes figures, soldiers, and a large cross. Buildings are in the background. The drawing has detailed line work and shading. In the foreground, multiple figures interact.

artworks.title: The Nailing to the Cross
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene depicting a large gathering with several dynamic groupings. The image shows a busy and intense scene with a number of figures engaged in various activities. In the foreground, various figures are wielding spears and guiding the onlookers' attention to the center of the scene where other figures are actively working with long wooden beams. To the right, a crowd has gathered, standing on an elevated area, appearing as if watching an event unfold. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shadings to illustrate the figures' clothing and the rugged terrain. The entire composition creates a narrative of an absorbed crowd witnessing a substantive event or ritual.
